cases.scenario: Import one Issue whose comments require more than one API page.
cases.expected: All pages are imported in order without requesting any other repository resource.

cases.scenario: Import one Pull Request with conversation comments, review bodies, and inline comments.
cases.expected: Contributions are deduplicated by kind and ID and sorted deterministically.

cases.scenario: Import an updated saved JSON snapshot with the same canonical thread URL.
cases.expected: The source ID remains stable and exactly one new current SourceVersion is created.
